titulo_ru: Источник и цитата в научном тексте
titulo_es: Sources and citations in scientific texts
intro: He seeks who makes each statement and what source he supports it; an assigned quote is not the same as a conclusion of the author.

bloques.titulo: He seeks who makes each statement and what source he supports it; an assigned quote is not the same as a conclusion of the author.
texto: He seeks who makes each statement and what source he supports it; an assigned quote is not the same as a conclusion of the author.
Forms such as согласно отчту and по данным авторов attribute information and limit its scope.

frases.ru: Согласно отчёту университета, число заявок выросло на 12 процентов.
frases.es: Según el informe de la universidad, el número de solicitudes aumentó un 12 por ciento.
frases.en: According to the university report, the number of applications increased by 12 per cent.

frases.ru: Авторы ссылаются на данные за три года, а собственный вывод формулируют отдельно.
frases.es: Los autores citan datos de tres años y exponen su propia conclusión por separado.
frases.en: The authors cite three-year data and set out their own separate conclusion.

bloques.pregunta: What expression does the figure attribute to a source?

opciones.explicacion: Согласно identifies the report from which the data comes.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The authors cite three-year data and set out their own separate conclusion.
